name: ukemi-jj
description: Jujutsu (jj) version control GUI: change graph, drag and drop rebase, hunk split, undo, GitHub PRs and GitLab MRs.

viewsWelcome.contents: No bookmarks. Right-click a change in the graph → Set Bookmark…

ukemi.jjPath.description: Path to the jj binary. Empty means search PATH and common install folders.

ukemi.addJjToTerminalPath.description: Add the jj binary that Ukemi downloaded to PATH in integrated terminals.

enumDescriptions: Show for jj repositories that the Git extension does not show.
ukemi.showSourceControl.description: Show jj working copy changes in the Source Control view.

ukemi.showInPanel.description: Open the change graph in an editor tab instead of the side bar.

ukemi.showEditorTitleDiff.description: Show an "Open Changes (jj)" button in the editor title.

ukemi.followActiveEditor.description: Switch to the repository of the active editor.

ukemi.repoScanDepth.description: How many folder levels to search for repositories inside each workspace folder.

ukemi.repoScanExclude.description: Folder names to skip during the repository search.

enumDescriptions: Your open changes, bookmarks and tags in the time range.
Your open changes, and your history in the time range.
The changes connected to the working copy.
The working copy and its last 5 first parents.
ukemi.defaultFilter.description: Filter that the change graph shows first.

ukemi.historyDepth.description: Default history depth of the change graph.

ukemi.changeIdLength.description: Minimum number of change ID characters to show.

ukemi.showFullPaths.description: Show full file paths in the change graph.

ukemi.showLineStats.description: Show added and removed line counts on the working copy and on changed files. This reads those file contents on each refresh.

ukemi.showGitTags.description: Show git tags on changes in the graph.

ukemi.workspaces.snapshotOnRefresh.description: On each refresh, snapshot every other workspace so its file changes show up. Each snapshot is a jj operation and can race with jj running in that workspace.

ukemi.changedFilesView.description: How changed files appear under a change in the graph.

ukemi.autoFetch.enabled.description: Fetch the active repository on a timer.

ukemi.autoFetch.interval.patternErrorMessage: Use a positive number and a unit: s, m, h or d. For example 10m or 1.5h. The minimum is 10 seconds.
ukemi.autoFetch.interval.description: How often to fetch the active repository when auto fetch is on. Any positive number with a unit: 45s, 10m, 1.5h, 2d.

ukemi.github.hosts.description: Additional GitHub Enterprise hosts, for example github.example.com.

ukemi.gitlab.hosts.description: Additional self-hosted GitLab hosts, for example git.example.com.

ukemi.gitlab.oauthApplications.markdownDescription: GitLab OAuth application client IDs, keyed by host. The client ID is not a secret. Example: `{ "git.example.com": "abc123" }`. Create a non-confidential application with the `api` scope and redirect URIs `vscode://samuelba.ukemi-jj/gitlab-auth` and `cursor://samuelba.ukemi-jj/gitlab-auth`.

ukemi.forge.ciOnlyMine.description: Show CI status only on open merge and pull requests that you authored.

ukemi.forge.requestLimit.description: How many of the most recently updated merge and pull requests to load. Each request returns at most 100, so a higher value loads more pages.

ukemi.forge.statusInterval.patternErrorMessage: Use a positive number and a unit: s, m, h or d. For example 60s or 5m. The minimum is 10 seconds.
ukemi.forge.statusInterval.description: How often to reload merge and pull request status. While one of your pipelines is running, Ukemi checks four times as often, and never under 10 seconds.
